I found no crystallization unit in this version's model list. It has no solids phase and no NaCl crystallization property package (`NaClParameterBlock`). Its only flash units are the TP and PH flashes, and the case needs a crystallizer with a yield specification and a Sol phase. A flash or a component separator would be a substitute, so I built nothing.
